name: Glarcherhof - Ferienhof Thaler
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated above the Thiersee valley, Glarcherhof invites guests to experience genuine Tyrolean farm life. Cosy rooms and apartments featuring warm timber accents provide peaceful relaxation.

Lake Thiersee, panoramic trails around Mount Pendling, and Kufstein Fortress are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Glarcherhof Ferienhof Thaler in Thiersee offers countryside farm holidays amidst scenic alpine meadows.
